summary: Feed s085_single to IDS is degraded due to high duplicate rate (28.4%, 940/3311 packets) exceeding 5% threshold. All other checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLAN, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding duplicate copies of the same packets to the IDS, most likely from aggregating overlapping SPAN sessions or dual TAP feeds without deduplication. 28.4% duplicates indicates the same traffic is being mirrored from two points in the path and merged without dedup.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes cycles processing 28% duplicate packets, inflates flow/connection counts, breaks TCP reassembly and stream detection, causes false-positive alerts and risks missing true attacks due to resource exhaustion and state table bloat.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet deduplication on the packet broker for feed s085_single to deliver a single copy of each packet to the IDS, restoring accurate detection and freeing IDS capacity.
